widthFailed: Could not save the menu width.
unsaved: Unsaved app settings. Save to keep them, or discard to undo.
saved: Saved on this computer. Applies across workspaces.
textHelp: Size the menus, forms, records and dialogs for comfortable reading. Website text is set separately in Appearance.
sampleBody: Record a result, describe an idea, or revisit a question.
headerHelp: Align and order the workspace name and logos. These app settings stay on this computer; website headers are configured in the website editor.
layoutHelp: Place the main menu where it suits your work. These settings apply on this computer; your published website keeps its own layout.
collapsed: Hide the menu until I need it
themeHelp: Choose how Observanda looks on this computer, or create your own theme. Your theme changes every screen, panel and dialog.
themeStartingHelp: Starting themes stay as they are. Create your own theme to choose its colours, fonts and shapes.
contrastLow: hard to read: choose more contrast
themeDeleteConfirm: Delete the theme "{name}"? The app returns to the theme it started from.
